output.reason: The release note [ev-cd466139dded] says the new `tenantID` option is for AzureDNS when using managed identities. The CRD schemas show that `spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.tenantID` already existed in v1.16.0 [ev-84061d76ea1b], so that field is not new. The field that is new in v1.17.0 is `spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID` [ev-60054fcf0986]. The subject should be that managedIdentity field, and the change type stays "added".

correction.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds an optional `tenantID` field to the AzureDNS DNS01 solver's managed identity configuration (spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID on Issuer), so users can set the tenant ID when using managed identities.
